text:
mina: quick report — reproducible off-by-one in KV index when serving int8-fused on very long contexts (~30k). float16 OK.
oscar: minimal repro? did you try toggling prefetch_kv or buffer sizes?
mina: repro script below, prefetch=false shifts point but doesn't fix. buffer 32768/65536 same.

```
# curl to local runtime
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-13b-int8-fused","input":"<30k prompt>"}' | jq .out[23880:23900]
```

hannah: logs show attn_idx stuck one behind at token ~23900 and a WARN ring_wrap delta=-1.
oscar: smells like truncation in compiled kernel index typedefs. did the int8 codegen change INDEX_T?
mina: yes, int8 pipeline lowered an index to 32-bit in IR; forcing 64-bit fixes repro but slows perf ~4%.
hannah: suggest guarded promotion: only use int64 arithmetic when MAX_CTX > threshold and add a longctx unit test for quant builds.
mina: opened PR with guarded casts + longctx-smoke; CI queued.
ci-bot: build 2026.04.02-int8-fuse completed  tests: 220 passed, 6 flaky (longctx).
oscar: add telemetry counter for attn_ring_delta_non1_total so we can detect in prod.
mina: will add metric + alert and run 48h staging with int8 once CI green. thanks!
